channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-125214 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in pcm_bluray_decode_frame() in libavcodec/pcm-bluray.c on big-endian hosts. Attackers can supply a crafted Blu-ray (M2TS) LPCM stream whose payload length is not a multiple of the sample size, writing attacker-controlled bytes past the audio frame buffer.

item.title: CVE-2026-125215 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in ff_dovi_rpu_generate() in libavcodec/dovi_rpuenc.c that allows attackers to crash applications via crafted Dolby Vision RPU metadata. Attackers can supply streams with default or alternating omitted DM blocks to the dovi_rpu bitstream filter with compression enabled, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-125216 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavcodec/dpxenc.c that allows attackers to crash the process via unvalidated bits_per_raw_sample for RGB48 input. Attackers can supply a 12-bit RGB image, such as JPEG 2000, that when transcoded to DPX selects encode_gbrp12() and dereferences NULL plane pointers, causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-125217 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory use vulnerability in roq_dpcm_encode_frame() in libavcodec/roqaudioenc.c that encodes stale heap contents when flushed early. Attackers can supply short audio streams under eight frames for RoQ DPCM transcoding, causing DPCM-quantized uninitialized heap data from frame_buffer to leak into output packets.

item.title: CVE-2026-125218 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the APNG encoder's encode_apng() function in libavcodec/pngenc.c when frame size changes mid-stream. Attackers can supply crafted media whose resolution grows mid-stream, causing APNG_DISPOSE_OP_BACKGROUND memset writes past prev_frame and crashing or corrupting heap memory in transcoding applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-125219 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vdpau_hevc_start_frame() in libavcodec/vdpau_hevc.c that copies unbounded PPS tile counts into fixed-size VDPAU arrays. Attackers can supply crafted HEVC bitstreams with excessive tile columns or rows to write controlled 16-bit values past heap-allocated hwaccel data, corrupting memory in applications using VDPAU decoding.

item.title: CVE-2026-125220 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a deadlock vulnerability in mimic_decode_frame() in libavcodec/mimic.c that fails to report frame progress when init_get_bits8() fails. Attackers can supply a crafted file with an oversized Mimic intra frame followed by inter frames to hang frame-threaded decoding indefinitely.

item.title: CVE-2026-125221 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in score_header() in libavcodec/flac_parser.c that allows attackers to exhaust the thread stack via crafted FLAC input. Attackers can supply a FLAC stream packed with many small valid-looking frame headers, forcing deep recursion that crashes the process during demuxing or parsing.

item.title: CVE-2026-125222 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in hap_parse_frame_header() in libavcodec/hapdec.c that allows attackers to trigger a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit builds. Attackers can craft Hap video frames with Snappy length prefixes that wrap tex_size, causing decompress_chunks_thread() to write outside tex_buf and crash the application or potentially execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-125223 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg 8.0 through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in the VP9 decoder that allows attackers to exhaust memory because vp9_decode_frame() skips resetting the CBS fragment on error paths. Attackers can supply a crafted VP9 stream with invalid tile sizes decoded with slice threading to leak packet buffers and units, exhausting memory in the decoding application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125224 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in libavcodec/vorbis_parser.c that re-parses invalid extradata for every packet when valid_extradata remains false. Attackers can supply crafted Ogg or Matroska Vorbis streams with large invalid extradata and many packets to exhaust CPU during demuxing or probing.

item.title: CVE-2026-125225 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in aac_adtstoasc_filter() that allows attackers to crash applications via oversized ADTS AAC packets. Attackers can supply a crafted file with a packet over 256 MB, overflowing the bit count so init_get_bits() fails unchecked and get_bits() crashes during MP4, Matroska, FLV or LATM remuxing.

item.title: CVE-2026-125226 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in sbg_read_header() in libavformat/sbgdec.c that derives an unbounded default frame size from the script's sample rate. Attackers can supply a crafted SBaGen script declaring a very high -r sample rate so the wavesynth decoder allocates enormous audio frames, exhausting memory and causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-125227 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in cbs_jpeg_write_scan() in libavcodec/cbs_jpeg.c that causes a heap buffer overflow on 32-bit builds. Attackers can supply a crafted MJPEG/JPEG stream with a scan of 512 MiB or more, processed by CBS bitstream filters like filter_units, to corrupt the heap or crash the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125228 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.8 | FFmpeg before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in put_vector() in libavcodec/vorbisenc.c when NaN samples leave the codebook entry at -1. Attackers can supply audio with NaN float samples to the native Vorbis encoder, causing heap reads before arrays that crash the application or leak adjacent heap memory into output.

item.title: CVE-2026-125229 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the encode_frame() function of libavcodec/huffyuvenc.c, because encode_init() never validates minimum frame dimensions for the median predictor. Attackers can supply a tiny video, such as a 2-pixel-wide or 1-2-pixel-tall frame, that causes negative sub_median_pred lengths and out-of-bounds reads and writes when transcoded to huffyuv or ffvhuff, crashing the encoder.

item.title: CVE-2026-125230 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the pcm_rechunk bitstream filter that allows attackers to trigger division by zero via a crafted channel count. Attackers can supply a file declaring a huge channel count that is remuxed into MXF, GXF or DAUD, overflowing sample_size and crashing the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125231 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg 4.4 through 9.0.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in libavcodec/adxdec.c because adx_decode_header() updates the channel layout before validating the sample rate. Attackers can supply a crafted ADX/AAX stream with mid-stream new-extradata side data carrying an invalid sample rate, causing adx_decode() to write through NULL plane pointers and crash the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125232 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a division by zero vulnerability in estimate_motion_b() in libavcodec/motion_est.c, caused by frame timestamp distances truncated to 16 bits. Attackers can supply input with timestamp gaps that are multiples of 65536, crashing MPEG-4 Part 2 or MPEG-1/2 B-frame encoding with SIGFPE.

item.title: CVE-2026-125233 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in dvbsub_encode() in libavcodec/dvbsubenc.c that undercounts each CLUT segment header by two bytes. Attackers can supply a file with many bitmap subtitle rectangles that, when transcoded to the dvbsub encoder, writes past the output buffer and corrupts heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125234 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in wavpack_encode_init() in libavcodec/wavpackenc.c that causes an infinite loop when computing block size from sample rate and channel count. Attackers can supply a crafted audio file, such as a WAV header declaring a huge sample rate with many channels, to hang applications transcoding to WavPack.

item.title: CVE-2026-125235 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap overflow vulnerability in libavcodec/qsvenc.c that allows attackers to corrupt memory by reusing an undersized pooled QSVFrame buffer when input dimensions increase. Attackers can supply crafted input whose resolution grows mid-stream, transcoded with Intel Quick Sync encoders without rescaling, to crash the application or corrupt heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125236 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in alloc_frame() in libavcodec/vvc/refs.c that leaks SPS and PPS references when frame buffer allocation fails. Attackers can supply a crafted VVC (H.266) stream that repeatedly replaces parameter sets, steadily growing memory use and causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-125237 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg 8.1 through 9.0.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in libavcodec/dpx.c that leaves dpx->hwaccel_picture_private allocated when Vulkan hwaccel callbacks fail. Attackers can supply crafted DPX images that make start_frame, decode_slice or end_frame fail, triggering an av_assert0 abort on the next frame and terminating the decoding application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125238 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a reachable assertion vulnerability in libxevd_receive_frame() in libavcodec/libxevd.c that returns success when an access unit produces no frame. Attackers can supply a crafted EVC file with truncated or picture-less access units to trigger the av_assert0() on frame->private_ref, aborting any decoding application.

item.title: CVE-2026-125239 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in ff_dxva2_hevc_fill_picture_parameters() that allows attackers to corrupt memory via unbounded non-uniform tile counts. Attackers can supply crafted HEVC bitstreams with many non-uniformly spaced tiles to write controlled 16-bit values past fixed-size DXVA arrays during DXVA2, D3D11VA, or D3D12VA decoding on Windows.

item.title: CVE-2026-125240 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a resource leak vulnerability in svt_jpegxs_dec_decode() in libsvtjpegxsdec.c that leaks decoder instances when ff_set_dimensions() rejects frame dimensions. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG XS stream, for example in MPEG-TS, with oversized headers to repeatedly leak decoder threads and buffers, exhausting memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125241 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavcodec/flicvideo.c that allows attackers to write out of bounds because check_pixel_ptr() checks only one bound with negative-stride frames. Attackers can supply a crafted FLIC file whose RLE and delta chunks write pixel data past frame storage, corrupting heap memory to crash applications or possibly execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-125242 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in libavcodec/vdpau.c that allows attackers to exhaust heap memory by aborting pictures before end_frame. Attackers can supply crafted H.264 streams with malformed NAL units that repeatedly abandon pictures, leaking the bitstream_buffers table continuously and causing denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-125243 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in ff_jpegls_decode_picture() in libavcodec/jpeglsdec.c, which decodes 16-bit line-interleaved JPEG-LS scans as 8-bit samples. Attackers can supply a crafted single-component JPEG-LS image with the ILV byte set to 1, causing decoded GRAY16 frames to expose leftover heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125244 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the VVC decoder's sh_entry_points() function in libavcodec/vvc/ps.c. Attackers can supply a crafted VVC (H.266) bitstream whose SPS/PPS tile and WPP layout produces excess entry points, overflowing entry_point_start_ctu and corrupting decoder memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125245 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a memory leak vulnerability in ff_mjpeg_decode_sof() in libavcodec/mjpegdec.c, which overwrites the hwaccel_picture_private pointer without freeing it. Attackers can supply crafted MJPEG streams with repeated SOF markers or failing frames to leak hwaccel private data and hardware buffers under VAAPI or NVDEC decoding.

item.title: CVE-2026-125246 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.7 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in cbs_jpeg_assemble_fragment() that miscounts 0xff stuffing bytes in JPEG scan headers. Attackers can supply a crafted JPEG/MJPEG stream with 0xff in the scan header, triggering an av_assert0 abort when CBS-based bitstream filters process it.

item.title: CVE-2026-125247 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in dng_decode_tiles() that allows attackers to leak uninitialized memory via crafted DNG tile dimensions. Attackers can set TileWidth or TileLength near INT_MAX so the tile loop never runs, outputting a frame exposing uninitialized or stale heap memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-125248 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg 9.0 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in libavcodec/ffv1enc_vulkan.c that undersizes the float remap GPU buffer for large frames. Attackers can supply large GBRPF32 or GBRAPF32 images or videos that, when transcoded to FFV1 with the Vulkan encoder, trigger out-of-bounds GPU memory writes causing crashes or memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2026-125249 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in ff_vk_decode_add_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_decode.c that miscalculates the Vulkan hwaccel bitstream buffer size. Attackers can supply a crafted stream with over 2 GiB of slice data per frame, causing memcpy() to write past a smaller pooled host-mapped buffer.

item.title: CVE-2026-125250 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow in the GIF encoder's gif_image_write_image() in libavcodec/gif.c because shrunk_buf is sized from the first frame's linesize. Attackers can supply PAL8 video whose frame linesize grows mid-stream, causing remap_frame_to_palette() to write past shrunk_buf and corrupt the heap during GIF transcoding.

item.title: CVE-2026-125251 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the VVC decoder alloc_frame() function in libavcodec/vvc/refs.c that undersizes the reference picture list allocation on 32-bit builds. Attackers can supply a crafted VVC (H.266) file with a very large number of NAL units per access unit to trigger heap out-of-bounds writes and corrupt memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-12977 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | A flaw was found in the deployment-operation family of WildFly Core. Certain handlers, such as upload-deployment-url, lack proper sensitivity classification, allowing an administrator with the restricted "Maintainer" role to read sensitive configuration files. This can lead to the exfiltration of credentials and full administrative control (SuperUser) of the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-70555 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Monday 9 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | rConfig Core 8.2.3 before 8.2.13 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retrieve cleartext SSH, Telnet, and enable passwords for managed devices through the device-credentials API due to automatic decryption on read and missing authorization checks. Attackers can request GET /api/device-credentials, GET /api/device-credentials/{id}, or the external GET /api/v1/device-credentials endpoint, which authenticates any valid token as the seeded administrator account, to statelessly exfiltrate all stored plaintext device credentials. rConfig Pro is not affected.
